items.title: Live: Iran targets US bases, US hits Iranian ports as Mid-East ceasefire collapses
items.description: US President Donald Trump says the US is reinstating its blockade of Iran in the Strait of Hormuz and will start charging for ships from elsewhere to transit through it. Follow live.

items.title: Middle East 'chaos' could see millions of motorists slugged again as oil surges
items.description: The recent closure of the Strait of Hormuz saw the oil price lift, but buying in the market accelerated following Donald Trump's latest Truth Social post.

items.title: Professor hired private investigator after protest, commission hears
items.description: Jewish Australian professor Steven Prawer says he paid a private investigator to try to find out whether people who occupied his University of Melbourne office were students on his campus.

items.title: Breaking: Teen in life-threatening condition after Brisbane school stabbing
items.description: Emergency services were called to the Islamic College of Brisbane in Karawatha just before midday after reports of an altercation between two students.

items.title: Four more charges dropped against Alan Jones
items.description: With a months-long hearing due to begin in early August, Sydney's Downing Centre Local Court is conducting several weeks of pre-trial hearings.

items.title: Ex-cop turned missing persons expert says he may know where Peter Falconio is
items.description: Jim Whitehead has helped to close some of Australia's most high-profile missing persons cases, including those of Daniel Morcombe and Allison Baden-Clay. Now he is looking to help find the remains of British backpacker Peter Falconio.

items.title: Bird flu detection training to be rolled out to volunteers
items.description: Training to help volunteers identify potential cases of bird flu will be rolled out in South Australia, under a partnership between conservation groups and government.

items.title: How our property obsession killed productivity
items.description: With housing prices coming off the boil, maybe our banks will start lending to more productive areas of the economy, like business.

items.title: Shark threat closes popular beaches, snorkelling spots along Ningaloo coast
items.description: Authorities save one animal but another succumbs to its injuries, leading sharks to converge on a popular snorkelling spot.

items.title: ICE agents shoot and kill driver who witnesses say 'tried to stop'
items.description: A federal immigration officer has fatally shot a motorist in Maine, the second time in a week that US Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents have used deadly force.

items.title: Property developers are benefiting from Australia's housing crisis
items.description: State and federal governments are offering incentives for property developers in exchange for more affordable housing. But a Four Corners investigation has uncovered major flaws in the strategy.

items.title: Sam Neill on his career, dying and the role he turned down
items.description: Looking back at the wisdom and insight of the beloved New Zealand actor.

items.title: Mixed martial arts group attempts to gift $82k cognac to Brisbane Olympic committee
items.description: The gifts, revealed exclusively by the ABC today, are part of a wider series of examples of attempted influence-peddling from businesses and sporting bodies before the Games kick off in 2032.

items.title: Police arrest alleged organiser behind Melbourne hospitality arson attacks
items.description: Investigators say the 20-year-old man was a high-ranking member of The Commission, an organised crime group believed to have targeted the city's nightlife venues in recent months.

items.title: 'I lost a normal childhood': What it is like being a young carer
items.description: Kenny and Naomi were both younger than 10 when they became carers for family members.

items.title: Don't ask? Don't get: Five places to negotiate your bills to save money
items.description: Negotiating to reduce your spending and increase your income are tangible ways you can improve your financial situation right now.

items.title: ABC Places quiz: Where in the world are we?
items.description: Your challenge in the ABC Places quiz is to work out the location of 10 photos from around the world. Be warned: we might try to trick you.

items.title: Signs of sugar detected near centre of the Milky Way
items.description: Astronomers have detected signs of a type of sugar found in raspberries in gas clouds near the centre of our galaxy the Milky Way.

items.title: Australian lamb new favourite in US as protein 'wave' creates demand
items.description: Australians may love their lamb, but it has always been a harder sell for American consumers. There are signs that is changing.

items.title: Spain 'here to suffer' and France unites against racism ahead of World Cup semi
items.description: Spain is invoking the aura of the Roman Empire, while France is lighting up the pitch and remaining united off it, ahead of their men's World Cup semi-final in Dallas.

items.title: Man who sneaked into Australia 45 years ago has lived in limbo until now
items.description: Kwong Wan Lo stowed away on a ship bound for Australia 45 years ago. With no legal right to stay, he built a life in Sydney anyway.

items.title: Former AFL player remembered as inspiration and 'great human' who loved life
items.description: A former AFL player has been remembered for his larger-than-life personality after being hit by a car and killed on Saturday night in Tasmania.

items.title: 'Coordinator' of Sydney grandfather's mistaken kidnapping murder charged
items.description: A man accused of coordinating the alleged murder and kidnapping of Sydney grandfather Chris Baghsarian has been charged.

items.title: Memorial plaques for brothers to be reinstated as council reverses decision
items.description: Beachside memorial plaques honouring two brothers who died in separate freak accidents will be reinstalled after their family's battle with a local council south of Perth.

items.title: Vehicle seized but no arrests after fatal Logan hit-and-run
items.description: A 20-year-old pedestrian died after he was struck on Middle Road at Greenbank shortly before 9pm.
